_README: Perf baselines for the crossdesk microbench gate. Values in nanoseconds (mean), keyed by pytest-benchmark test id. bench_check.py fails a test that runs more than _threshold_pct slower than its baseline. MEASURED 2026-07-14 on ubuntu-latest GitHub runners -- the environment the gate actually runs in -- from 3 successive green main builds; run-to-run spread was 1-3%, so each baseline is the WORST of the three and the 20% threshold is real headroom rather than slack. Before this, 6 of 11 entries were 0 (collect-only, gating nothing) and the rest were round placeholders with up to 66% slack, so 'microbench passes' proved nothing. Re-measure in a dedicated PR with the evidence attached if the hardware or the code shape changes.
